title: Storm Island Defender
theme: A floating archipelago of colorful islands is besieged by chaotic storm clouds that drop disruptive lightning bolts. The player must place protective towers—wind turbines, water sprinklers, and luminous balloons—to intercept the bolts and preserve the islands' stability.
mechanics: Place defensive towers along a path to block incoming threats
Upgrade towers to increase interception range and power
Survive multiple waves of lightning bolts without letting any hit the islands
Manage limited resources (energy crystals) to afford tower upgrades
